response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few quick confirmations before I change or delete any mail.

1) Which messages exactly do you want removed?
- All messages from noreply@transitalerts.net
- Only in Inbox (not Sent/All Mail)
- Only unread, or only read
- Only older than a certain age — pick one: 30 days, 90 days (recommended), 1 year, or give a custom date

2) What action should I take?
- Archive (removes from Inbox but keeps mail)
- Move to Trash / Delete (goes to Trash and is permanently removed after ~30 days)
- Apply a label and archive (keeps a record)

3) Do you want a preview first?
- I can list (or show subject + date for) up to 50 of the messages that match so you can confirm before I act.

Tell me your choices for 1–3 and I’ll proceed only after you confirm.
